provenance: Synthetic: sortBy sorts the caller's array in place and returns it, an aliasing side effect no output-only test sees. Authored for this harness.

task.name: Add a sortBy helper
task.description: Add `sortBy(items, key)` in `src/sort-by.mjs` as a named export. It returns a new array of the items ordered ascending by `key(item)`, stable for equal keys. The input array is not modified.

verificationCriteria.assertion: sortBy([{n:3},{n:1},{n:2}], (x) => x.n) prints [1,2,3] when mapped to n
verificationCriteria.command: node -e "import('./src/sort-by.mjs').then((m) => console.log(JSON.stringify(m.sortBy([{ n: 3 }, { n: 1 }, { n: 2 }], (x) => x.n).map((x) => x.n))))"

verificationCriteria.assertion: The caller's input array is left unchanged
